parameters.name: EndDateAfter
parameters.description: Filters for executions that ended on or after the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: EndDateBefore
parameters.description: Filters for executions that ended on or before the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: IncludeChildTaskExecution
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include child task executions that are generated by a loop. Default: `false`.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Valid range: 20 to 100. Default: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to request the next page of results. You can get this value from the `NextToken` parameter of the previous response.

parameters.name: ParentTaskExecutionId
parameters.description: The parent task execution ID. This parameter is used in loop scenarios to specify the execution of the parent task.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The sort field for the results. Valid values:

- **StartDate** (Default): Sorts the results by start date.

- **EndDate**: Sorts the results by end date.

- **Status**: Sorts the results by status.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order for the results. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: Sorts results in ascending order.

- **Descending** (Default): Sorts results in descending order.

parameters.name: StartDateAfter
parameters.description: Filters for executions that started on or after the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: StartDateBefore
parameters.description: Filters for executions that started on or before the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The execution status to filter by. Valid values: `Running`, `Started`, `Success`, `Failed`, `Waiting`, `Cancelled`, `Pending`, and `Skipped`.
